name: ArxivChecker
description: Turn a finished study into a paper you can trace, rebuild and review.
status: Local capability and website. Publication has not been performed.

claim_example.label: Fictional teaching example; not a study result
claim_example.before: The system saved half the cost.
claim_example.after: On this held-out task set, priced model calls cost half as much as the baseline. Setup, unpriced calls and human review are excluded.

checks.title: Find the source
checks.body: Link the statement to an exact result file, field and extraction command. A sentence in an earlier draft is not a source.

checks.title: Name the comparison
checks.body: Use the same tasks, success criterion and accounting scope for the system and baseline. State the denominator and every exclusion.

checks.title: Keep the units
checks.body: Separate cost per call, per task and for the whole study. Record assumed prices and their date rather than treating an estimate as a bill.

checks.title: Bound the conclusion
checks.body: Say what the evidence supports. Model-call savings on one test do not establish total cost savings or general performance.
